hooks.name: Document API Routes on Save
hooks.description: Remind to document API endpoints when a routes file is saved

action.prompt: A route file inside apps/api was just saved. Check whether the routes it defines are documented. If any endpoint is missing JSDoc or an OpenAPI/Swagger comment describing its method, path, request body, query params, and response shape, flag each missing one and add minimal inline documentation. Do not change any business logic.
